## agent-ml-research
ML research experiment management tools

attachment.content:
- update-config: Use this skill to configure the Claude Code harness via settings.json. Automated behaviors ("from now on when X", "each time X", "whenever X", "before/after X") require hooks configured in settings.json - the harness executes these, not Claude, so memory/preferences cannot fulfill them. Also use for: permissions ("allow X", "add permission", "move permission to"), env vars ("set X=Y"), hook troubleshooting, or any changes to settings.json/settings.local.json files. Examples: "allow npm commands", "add bq permission to global settings", "move permission to user settings", "set DEBUG=true", "when claude stops show X". For simple settings like theme/model, suggest the /config command.
- keybindings-help: Use when the user wants to customize keyboard shortcuts, rebind keys, add chord bindings, or modify ~/.claude/keybindings.json. Examples: "rebind ctrl+s", "add a chord shortcut", "change the submit key", "customize keybindings".
- simplify: Review changed code for reuse, quality, and efficiency, then fix any issues found.
- fewer-permission-prompts: Scan your transcripts for common read-only Bash and MCP tool calls, then add a prioritized allowlist to project .claude/settings.json to reduce permission prompts.
- loop: Run a prompt or slash command on a recurring interval (e.g. /loop 5m /foo). Omit the interval to let the model self-pace. - When the user wants to set up a recurring task, poll for status, or run something repeatedly on an interval (e.g. "check the deploy every 5 minutes", "keep running /babysit-prs"). Do NOT invoke for one-off tasks.
- schedule: Create, update, list, or run scheduled remote agents (routines) that execute on a cron schedule. - When the user wants to schedule a recurring remote agent, set up automated tasks, create a cron job for Claude Code, or manage their scheduled agents/routines. Also use when the user wants a one-time scheduled run ("run this once at 3pm", "remind me to check X tomorrow").
- claude-api: Build, debug, and optimize Claude API / Anthropic SDK apps. Apps built with this skill should include prompt caching. Also handles migrating existing Claude API code between Claude model versions (4.5 → 4.6, 4.6 → 4.7, retired-model replacements).
TRIGGER when: code imports `anthropic`/`@anthropic-ai/sdk`; user asks for the Claude API, Anthropic SDK, or Managed Agents; user adds/modifies/tunes a Claude feature (caching, thinking, compaction, tool use, batch, files, citations, memory) or model (Opus/Sonnet/Haiku) in a file; questions about prompt caching / cache hit rate in an Anthropic SDK project.
SKIP: file imports `openai`/other-provider SDK, filename like `*-openai.py`/`*-generic.py`, provider-neutral code, general programming/ML.
- init: Initialize a new CLAUDE.md file with codebase documentation
- review: Review a pull request
- security-review: Complete a security review of the pending changes on the current branch

- 结论：tokenization 非唯一原因，更可能是 Llama-2 架构 + LoRA + 长序列稀疏梯度的复合效应
- 决策：接受为 outlier，论文如实报告，不再投入 GPU 修复

## Universal Irreducible Ceiling (2026-05-16)
- 所有 4 个模型（Qwen-7B/1.5B, CodeLlama-13B, DeepSeek-6.7B）在 exception_only 条件下共享完全相同的 2 个错误：index 901, 905
- 均来自 HumanEval/95 (check_dict_case)：`all()` 短路 generator 产生 GeneratorExit，显示为 [ERROR] 但实际 pass
- 根因：exception_only 表示的语义歧义——不是模型能力问题，是表示层面的硬上限
- DeepSeek 额外 6 错来自 MBPP/113 (caught ValueError)，其他 3 模型能正确判断
- 论文价值：证明 2/1190 ceiling 是数据标注 artifact，非模型限制

## Error Analysis 核心发现 (2026-05-18, plan_018)
- Exception-based 条件（ae_only/exception_only/vota）错误 100% FN，零 FP — CI/CD 安全性
- **full_trace 100% 的错误都发生在 trace 被截断的样本上**：2048 token 截断后只剩 module imports 和内存地址，error/assert 标记全部丢失。这不是任务难度问题，是信息过载/截断问题 — 直接解释为什么 full_trace 不如 exception_only
- **截断的 trace 比没有 trace 更糟**：61 个样本在 no_trace 下正确但在 full_trace 下错误
- exception_only 2 个错误与其他条件零重叠（独有 failure mode = GeneratorExit edge case）
- no_trace 296 错中 140 个可被任意 trace 条件修复（FN 主导 206 vs 90 FP，模型保守偏向 fail）
- vota 7 错全部 FN，6 个来自 MBPP/113（try/except 捕获但 trace 仍显示 [ERROR]）
- 论文价值：information selectivity 叙事 + "truncation destroys signal" 强 claim

## Format Marker 贡献量 (2026-05-16)
- nomarker_seed42 (Qwen-7B): 96.55%，对比 exception_only_seed42 99.83% → marker 贡献 ~3.3pp
- nomarker_seed42 (Qwen-1.5B): 97.8%，证明 1.5B 无 marker 仍超 7B 无 marker
- 待 seed123/456 完成后取均值 ± std

## DeepSeek seed123 = 91.09% 异常 (已诊断)
- 根因：LoRA 初始化失败导致 truncation boundary 处 format collapse
- 不是信号不足问题，是随机种子 + 架构交互的 edge case

## Zero-Shot Baseline 设计决策 (2026-05-17)
- Qwen 用 generation-based（模型输出 yes/no，映射为 pass/fail）
- DeepSeek 用 logit-based classification（比较 yes/pass vs no/fail token logit），因为 DeepSeek chat template 生成解释性文本而非单词
- 两种方法都是公平的 zero-shot 评估，但方法差异可能部分解释 accuracy 差异（Qwen 89.08% vs DeepSeek 90.59%）
- 关键 insight：zero-shot 错误模式互补——Qwen 漏判 fail（fail recall 67%），DeepSeek 误判 pass 为 fail（pass recall 89%）
- Regex baseline (93.61%) > zero-shot LLM (~90%)：说明 exception trace 判别不是通用语言理解任务，pattern matching 反而更有效；SFT 提供 task-specific signal 才能突破

## Training Dynamics (2026-05-19, plan_022)
- Exception_only: step 50 即 99.33%，step 200 饱和 99.83%，几乎 trivial
- Full_trace: step 50 仅 87.39%，best 88.82% (step 350)，持续震荡不收敛，train loss 0.0085 但 acc 卡 88%

- 论文价值：直接支撑 "information density > information quantity" 核心叙事

## N3 Silent Logic Error 分析 (2026-05-19)
- 数据集中 55.5% (188/339) 的 fail 是 silent logic error（程序无异常，输出错误，测试 assert 失败）
- exception_only 对 silent error 也 100% recall——因为测试框架的 AssertionError 是 exception event
- full_trace 在 silent error 上最弱 (50%)——变量快照不含 error marker 时模型难以判断
- no_trace 和 loop_only 对 crash ~99% 但对 silent error 仅 ~63%，gap 32-39pp

- **方差与信号密度负相关**：exception_only (σ=0) < VOTA (σ=0.38pp) < full_trace (σ=1.12pp)
- exception_only vs VOTA: mean diff +0.78 ± 0.31pp, 2/3 seeds p<0.05, discordant pairs 一致性 7:2/16:2/11:2
- seed42 的 p=0.063 因天花板效应（discordant pairs 仅 9 个）

- Qwen-7B: seed42=85.63%, seed123=85.88%, seed456=86.64% — σ=0.53pp，稳定
- CodeLlama-13B: seed42=77.06%, seed123 RUNNING
- 与 Tier 1 (exception_only σ=0) 一致：Tier 2 也 seed-robust，signal density 不影响 seed stability
- 论文价值：可 claim seed robustness across tiers and models
